race.description: Picklebet's Hail Mary Multi Builder Hcp (Bm52)
race.comment: TIME ANGEL (1) just keeps running you an honest race. He lands up near the front and keeping rolling. All he has to do is run the 1200m right out and they will have more trouble getting by. Any track condition will suit too. WANNABEAPOODLE (2) will be resuming and is a winner first up. He does get back in the field so they will be needing to be able to run on. DOUBTFREE (10) probably wants further to be highly competitive but again if the pattern shows you can make ground, watch for him to do that. GARGANTUAN (6) did win the last outing but it was a much easier race. Has run the odd good race with the winkers on. ROWDY ANTHEM (7) is one who would be best placed if the track stayed on the dry side. Back to his more preferred distance in this.
